data.summary: The figures I checked match Tesla's reported fiscal 2024 results. Revenue was about $97.7B, up from $96.8B in 2023, which is roughly 0.9%. GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders was about $7.1B. Total assets were about $122.1B. Cash and cash equivalents were about $16.1B; this excludes short-term investments, which bring the total to about $36.6B. As your note instructed, I did not check the operating income figure because it was already verified.
